question: Does the PR #7249 normalization fix produce the pooled full-window token-mean SGD update when the actual Transformers Trainer.train optimizer loop, Accelerator.backward, and a real two-process CPU Gloo DDP reducer are exercised together?

estimand.loss: L = sum over active completion tokens across ranks and microbatches of clipped GRPO token loss / total active completion tokens in the optimizer window.
estimand.parameter_update: One SGD step with lr=0.1, weight_decay=0, no gradient clipping, compared to a direct full-window pooled-token oracle from the same initial parameters.
estimand.controls: Same token-local CPU model and sample multiset; prompt/context/padding positions masked; beta=0; auxiliary loss disabled.

scope.tested_path: Pinned AsyncGRPOTrainer.compute_loss and get_batch_samples + Transformers Trainer.train/_inner_training_loop/training_step + Accelerate.backward + actual DDP Gloo reducer/no_sync + real SGD optimizer/scheduler step.
scope.input_path: Trainer.get_train_dataloader is replaced with a deterministic rank-local DataLoader of the same rows emitted by DataCollatorForRollout; the real production rollout worker, planner, DataLoaderDispatcher scatter, and background lifecycle are bypassed.
not_tested: pretrained model, task success, or capability change
scope.prior_evidence: The v2 audit called production compute_loss and Accelerator model preparation with actual DDP, but used direct loss.backward and manual SGD; the PR-authored tests exercise Trainer.train in one process and simulate two-rank averaging.

acceptance.any_timeout_deadlock_nan_or_unexplained_: non-pass; preserve full per-rank and launcher logs

claim_limits: Synthetic correctness only: no policy capability or task-success claim.
The fixed SGD step is real but the data source and worker lifecycle are test fixtures.
This extends the open PR’s own normalization fix and does not establish algorithmic novelty or upstream acceptance.
Zero-token per-sequence diagnostic ratios are excluded from the locked primary gate; primary trainer loss, gradients, optimizer result must remain finite.
v2_reason: V1 was a harness failure before the first forward/backward: constructing the AsyncGRPO trainer through __new__ omitted step-accounting fields normally set by its constructor. V2 initializes those fields only. Source arms, samples, objective, runtime, and acceptance gates remain unchanged.
